reviews.name: Julie Bennett
reviews.pull: They went above and beyond what we expected.
reviews.text: My wife and I are extremely impressed with the customer service provided by Wahl A/C. They were prompt, courteous, and very professional. They went above and beyond what we expected in diagnosing and repairing our A/C unit. We would recommend Wahl A/C without hesitation. This is a first-class company that stands behind its customers.

reviews.name: Brandon Anderson
reviews.pull: They absolutely earned our loyalty and trust.
reviews.text: Wahl is one of a kind! Our AC went out and the lady that scheduled a tech to come out was very kind and extremely helpful getting someone out as quickly as possible. Robert was out to our house quickly and was also absolutely outstanding. He quickly diagnosed the issue, explained everything that was going on, and his plan to fix it and then did just that! Wahl was nothing but honest, fairly priced and fixed our issue quickly. They even provided pictures of the issue! We were dreading the issue once our AC went out, but you all gave us the best experience we never thought possible. They absolutely earned our loyalty and trust. Thank you so much to the entire Wahl team!!!!!

reviews.name: Mike Gawlik
reviews.pull: We have been using them for almost 40 years.
reviews.text: Wahl is a great company, we have been using them for almost 40 years. They are very professional and honest. They are fair on their pricing. We have purchased 7 air conditioning units from them in the houses we have owned and always use them for service. If you're looking for a great price and great service I would suggest you give them a call.

reviews.name: Rick Doucet
reviews.pull: The system shut down on one of the hottest days of the year — they were here within a couple of hours.
reviews.text: We bought our house 3 years ago Wahl had installed the HVAC system and when we had an issue with the unit they responded same day and quickly fixed the problem explaining in detail what had happened. Recently the system shut down on one of the hottest days of the year and they were here within a couple of hours. This has been one of the best experiences I have ever had with a service vendor.

reviews.name: Patricia Miller
reviews.pull: A second opinion saved me $6,000. You have a new customer for life.
reviews.text: I would highly recommend this company if you live in the west valley. They are a family owned business that have been around since 1957. I had received a reference from a friend after another company had come out for their annual service call. They again tried to sell me a bill of goods and it came to the tune of 6k. I have a 6 year old system. I decided on a second opinion. Chris promptly came to my residence, inspected the systems and guess what — none of the items on that list needed to be completed. Chris checked my system from head to toe and all that was needed was a small amount of Freon. I feel so much better working with a smaller local company like Wahl. They care about their customers and are not there to upsell repairs that are not necessary. They are honest and reliable. You have a new customer for life. Thanks Chris, thanks Wahl Air Conditioning.

reviews.name: Frank
reviews.pull: Daryl showed up for his last call at 6:00 pm on a Friday — and crawled into an insanely hot attic.
reviews.text: Just my luck. My air conditioning went down just as the temperatures hit 100 degrees. Also, we were scheduled to go back to Canada (we are snowbirds) for the summer season, and only had two days left before leaving. I immediately called Wahl as I had had them do some repairs in the past. They were able to accommodate me with a late day appointment to check out the problem. Daryl, their senior technician, showed up for his last call at 6:00 pm on a Friday. He had to crawl up into our attic, which was insanely hot, and found a dysfunctional capacitor, which he was able to replace with one that he had in his van. Based on my conversation with Daryl, I will likely have the entire system replaced, by them, when we get back for the next season. I was charged a very reasonable price for the repair. I would highly recommend Wahl to anyone needing air conditioning service.

reviews.name: TJ Comer
reviews.pull: So many duds out there — I feel lucky to have found Wahl's.
reviews.text: I feel confident with this company being truthful & reasonable with what is needed for my 3 air systems. Our tech, Robert, explains what he is going to do & why. He seems to have common sense and answers all my questions. The last two years I have requested Robert as our tech & the company does not act like it is a struggle to schedule a tech I like & trust. Wahl is amazing at contacting you quickly if you call via text. They are on top of it!! Thank you for being a great company!! Especially when there are so many duds out there that try to rob the consumer, I feel lucky to have found Wahl's.

reviews.name: Debbie
reviews.pull: I have used Wahl for about 17 years.
reviews.text: I have used Wahl Air Conditioning for about 17 years. They have always responded quickly when our A/C units had issues. I really appreciate that the technicians know what they are doing. Quick repairs & fair pricing.

reviews.name: Kellie Sanford
reviews.pull: Robert diagnosed a problem in five minutes and fixed it in 30. This company is my go-to.
reviews.text: This is a wonderful, locally owned company. They installed a new AC unit for me two years ago and did a great job. Recently had them out for a thermostat issue, it was resolved very quickly. Daryl was really helpful and explained the issue and gave me tips for any future problems. Robert came out and diagnosed a problem in five minutes and fixed it in 30. This company is my go-to.

reviews.name: RYAN NASSER
reviews.pull: Professional, honest, on time, and easy to work with from start to finish.
reviews.text: Wahl Air Conditioning did an awesome job. They were professional, honest, on time, and easy to work with from start to finish. The quality of their work really shows, and they took the time to explain everything clearly. It's hard to find companies that are reliable and trustworthy these days, but Wahl Air Conditioning definitely is. I'd highly recommend them to anyone needing AC service, repairs, or installation.

reviews.name: Gilbert Carrillo
reviews.pull: One of the last family run businesses. Dennis, now his son Chris, are great.
reviews.text: Have been using Wahl A/C for many years. Great service, honest system check, not trying to upsell you to a new system. One of the last family run businesses. Dennis, now his son Chris, are great. Here in AZ, you need to do preventative maintenance with annual system checks. Highly recommend them.

reviews.name: Marti Welter
reviews.pull: Hire Wahl to check the A/C before you buy a home — it saved us a lot of money.
reviews.text: I can't say enough great things about the ladies who schedule to the service techs at Wahl Air Conditioning! They did an excellent job servicing our current system and have helped us twice on diagnosing potential purchases for new homes. Before paying a general inspector on a home purchase, hire Wahl to check out the A/C & heating system — it can save A LOT of money and headaches, it did us! Thank you Wahl A/C!!

reviews.name: Vintage L
reviews.pull: Professional, on time, reliable, no-BS. They do not try to sell you anything extra.
reviews.text: Wahl air conditioning is professional, on time and reliable — no BS air conditioning company. They do not try to sell you anything extra. Honest with everything they do and also very knowledgeable in what they do with great prices. I will recommend to everyone.

reviews.name: Jim Fitch
reviews.pull: Both AC units replaced — started early morning, complete by midday.
reviews.text: The Wahl crew came out to replace both of my AC units, they started the jobs early in the morning and was complete by midday. The crew was very nice and professional and did an outstanding job. I'm very happy with the service and highly recommend this company for air conditioning services.

reviews.name: Cassy Allen
reviews.pull: By the time he left I felt like I'd known him for years.
reviews.text: Aaron was extremely friendly, very thorough and informative. He showed up when he said he would and by the time he left I felt like I'd known him for years, just a great guy working for an amazing company!

reviews.name: Derek Horn
reviews.pull: Scheduled same day — and the owner came and did the work.
reviews.text: I needed some work done on my air handler. Wahl was able to schedule me on the same day and it was the owner who came and did the work. Awesome! Thanks!

reviews.name: Joan F
reviews.pull: He waited till it completely updated and checked my app was working. Very impressed!
reviews.text: We had Arron from Wahl AC out to install a new Ecobee thermostat. He was great! Waited till it completely updated itself and checked my app was functioning properly. Very impressed!

reviews.name: Daryl Abbott
reviews.pull: Not all companies can do the professional work they do.
reviews.text: Very professional and knowledgeable. I would recommend them to everyone. Not all companies can do the professional work they do.

reviews.name: Doug Wahl
reviews.pull: Great system at a very good price.
reviews.text: Installed AC split system for the bedroom. Service techs were excellent, installed the system quickly, removed all old items and were very friendly. Great system at a very good price.

reviews.name: Patricia Brostrom
reviews.pull: Came early — was pleased with their work.
reviews.text: Very good, came early. Was pleased with their work. Thank you.

reviews.name: Amy Kubo
reviews.pull: Everyone was extremely helpful and timely.
reviews.text: Everyone was extremely helpful and timely in the process.

reviews.name: Tim McCullough
reviews.pull: Extremely honest and very upfront with any and all repairs.
reviews.text: Had them come out and do an AC inspection to make sure everything was good. They were extremely honest and very upfront with any and all repairs that were needed and recommended.

reviews.name: diane brown
reviews.pull: Above and beyond. Fairly priced with no upselling.
reviews.text: The company went above and beyond regarding service! Fairly priced with no up selling. I will continue to refer and use them for any A/C needs.

reviews.name: smille12
reviews.pull: No price gouging or upselling unnecessary work.
reviews.text: Robert was a pleasant technician who was thorough and professional. No price gouging or up selling unnecessary work. Support small businesses like Wahl — definitely will use again, thank you.

reviews.name: craig henkel
reviews.pull: A company that fixes the problem, without trying to sell you two or three other things.
reviews.text: It's a company that fixes the problem, without trying to sell you 2 or 3 other things. Very trustworthy. Great job.

reviews.name: Sara Jackson
reviews.pull: Four years with this company and I would not trade them for anything.
reviews.text: Wahl Air Conditioning's best employee, Daryl, did the annual fall checkup of my Evaporative Cooler. As usual, he did a thorough inspection of the cooler and everything associated with it, such as the thermostat. I have been working with this company for about 4 years and would not trade them for anything. I highly recommend Wahl Air Conditioning to everyone.

reviews.name: Gurmit Chahal
reviews.pull: Highly professional and meticulous.
reviews.text: Highly professional and meticulous execution of listed inspection to update the components as required.

reviews.name: Marie Speck
reviews.pull: You and your company jumped into action quickly!
reviews.text: Thank you Chris Wahl for your prompt action in contacting me and replacing my AC unit. Even though we live in Prescott Valley, it does get very warm here without cooling, and you and your company jumped into action quickly! Your crew was professional, courteous, and highly knowledgeable.
